name: Tombrack
questions: What is the large vehicle yard about 60 m north-east of the house (rows of several hundred cars on the 2024 satellite image)? Is it still operating, what are its hours, and does it bring trucks or noise past the gate?

Can you send a layout and sizes for the converted garage? Does it have its own kitchen, shower room and a bedroom upstairs, and was the conversion done with planning permission and building-regulation sign-off?
Is the house on mains water or a private well, and is drainage a septic tank or a treatment unit? How old is it, and is there a certificate?
BuyerIQ shows a mapped river flood zone about 100 m away: has the site, the drive or the lane ever flooded? And has a radon test been done?
Which parts of the acre are fenced or walled, and could the front lawn be closed in for two dogs?

ai.why: A sound single-storey 4-bed of 190 m² with four bathrooms, bright vaulted living rooms and a converted garage, on an acre. Held back by a large vehicle yard about 60 m away, €550k, and a 40-minute drive to the ED.

electricity.detail: Connected; an occupied modern house with solar panels on the garage roof, though the listing doesn't state the supply.

water.detail: Not stated; a rural house in Tombrack is probably on a private well or group scheme. Ask.

sewer.detail: Not stated; almost certainly a septic tank or treatment unit 4 km outside Ferns. Ask its age and for a certificate.

internet.detail: Fibre at the address per BuyerIQ ('Fast broadband: 102 Mb full fibre'); the listing doesn't mention broadband. Provider not confirmed; rural north Wexford is NBI territory.
internet.speed: ~100 Mb+ (up to 1 Gb on full fibre plans)

groundFloorBedroom.detail: The floor plan shows a single-storey house with all four bedrooms on the ground floor: the master bedroom (4) has a walk-in wardrobe and en suite, and bedroom 3 has its own en suite; the converted garage is a second option.

type: Detached single-storey house with a converted detached garage
bedsNote: All four bedrooms are on one level (three en suite, plus a family bathroom with a jacuzzi bath). The detached garage is converted to extra rooms: photos show a kitchenette, a living room with a stove and a stair to an upper room. There is also a floored attic.
heating: Oil-fired central heating; open fire with stove insert in the sitting room, solid-fuel stoves in the sunroom and the garage living room
tagline: A single-storey 4-bed of 190 m² with vaulted, beamed living rooms and a converted garage, on about an acre in Tombrack, about 4 km west of Ferns village.

pros.text: Every bedroom on the ground floor
pros.detail: Single storey per the floor plan: four bedrooms on one level, three en suite, with no stairs in the main house.

pros.text: Converted garage could be an annex
pros.detail: The detached garage has been converted to extra rooms; photos show a kitchenette, a living room with a stove and a stair to an upper room, so it could serve Gabor's parents or a let (no plan or sizes given).

pros.text: About an acre, set back from the lane
pros.detail: c.1 acre (0.4 ha) of lawns with a sweeping drive behind gates; the house stands about 70 m back from the local road (satellite estimate).
Sitting room 4.9 × 4.7 m with a vaulted, beamed ceiling and open fire, kitchen-dining 5.92 × 4.7 m with an island, a sunroom with a stove, and a floored attic.
Tombrack NS (co-ed, about 55 pupils) is 720 m away; Ferns village, its Centra and Ferns Health Centre are about 4 km.
BER B3 at 147.45 kWh/m²/yr, uPVC double glazing, oil heating; BuyerIQ lists 102 Mb full fibre at the address.

cons.detail: €50k above the usual ceiling for a house with no train link or period character; stamp duty about €5,500, and €2,895/m².

cons.text: Large vehicle yard about 60 m away
cons.detail: The August 2024 Esri satellite image shows several hundred parked cars in a yard about 60 m north-east, entered from the same lane about 80 m north of the gate, and a cluttered commercial yard about 110 m south-east. The council's waste register lists a vehicle storage permit (Murphy Van Parts) at Tombrack. The listing photos don't show it.
A modern rural bungalow; the vaulted ceilings and beams add warmth, but it isn't a period or stone house.

cons.text: Dublin train is a drive and about 2 hours
cons.detail: Enniscorthy station is about 15 km by road; 5 Dublin trains each weekday, about 1h50–2h20 to Connolly.
Wexford General (all ages) is about 29 km straight-line, roughly 40 km by road.
A cluster of about eight houses lines the lane; the nearest house is about 40 m south, so there are open fields on one side only.

BuyerIQ shows a mapped river flood zone about 0.1 km away, one hidden critical finding (fix €800–2,000, possibly radon) and 9 planning applications within 1 km; water, sewer and the garage conversion's paperwork aren't stated.
